title: Density of repelling periodic points for cubic rational maps
summary: We prove the repelling-density conjecture for cubic rational maps over $\mathbf C_p$: for every prime $p$, the classical Julia set is the closure of the classical repelling periodic points. By Bézivin's theorem, it suffices to prove that a nonempty classical Julia set contains a classical repelling periodic point. The case $p\geq5$ follows from known results for tame maps, so we treat residue characteristics two and three. We argue by contraposition, assuming that the map has no classical repelling periodic points. Maps with potential good reduction already have empty classical Julia set.…
